description: Elmhurst University has received a significant philanthropic gift that will establish an endowed professorship and a scholarship benefiting the university’s School of Business and its students.

title: UM launches new scholarship to help students afford college
description: The University of Montana and the UM Foundation announced Monday a fundraising effort to help Montana students access higher education at UM called the For Montana Scholarship Initiative.

title: 2026 Winners of the 32nd-Annual Eric Dostie Memorial College Scholarship Announced
description: Temecula, California, Aug. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nufactor®, a specialty infusion company and subsidiary of FFF Enterprises, Inc., is pleased to announce the names of its 2026 Eric Dostie Memorial College Scholarship recipients. The annual scholarship program - now in its 32nd year - grants 10 awards of $1,000 each to qualifying students affected by bleeding disorders who can best demonstrate scholastic achievement, community service, and financial need.

title: Azim Premji scholarship for girls announced
description: Azim Premji Foundation on Tuesday announced the launch of the Azim Premji scholarship for girls. The scholarship will support up to 20,000 girls this year to continue their higher education. Each selected student will receive ₹30,000 a year, from the first year of college until she completes her undergraduate degree or diploma.

title: Sogang University Opens a Full-Tuition Path for International STEM Graduate Students in Seoul
description: A state- and city-backed track pairs the Seoul ANCHOR Project with the university's own global scholarship, waiving 100 percent of tuition for selected students in the natural sciences and engineering - and adding research, internship and Korean-language support on top.

title: Odisha govt launches 'Bidesh Sikhyabruti' scheme to fund foreign higher education for SC, ST students
description: The Odisha government on Sunday launched the "Bidesh Sikhyabruti" scholarship scheme to provide financial assistance to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) students aspiring to pursue higher education at top-ranked global universities, the Chief Minister's Office (CMO) announced on Saturday.
